name: Aramachi Kiyomi
source:
She is a wife living in building C. She currently just lives with her son who is in kindergarten. She's effectively a single mother.

She is friends with Sawabe Akemi because their children attend the same kindergarten.

She works at a soapland at night.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bmwp.htmll]official site[/url]]
